---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / motivation

What problem are you trying to solve? What's frustrating or missing today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. If it involves a new command or flag, sketch the
interface (e.g. `brain <command> --flag`).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why they fall short.

## Scope

Which part of the brain would this touch? (search · ingest · GraphRAG ·
vault/wiki · MCP server · CLI · enrichment · other)

## Additional context

Screenshots, references, or examples. Note that changes are expected to land
test-first with the coverage floors in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
